label: Familiarity
description: Neighbours on the pitch (e.g. the centre-back pair, full-back and winger on the same side) who have started matches together. Grows with every match you play: each link counts fully after 3 matches together.

label: Back-line balance
description: +1 for each defender on his natural side: left-footed LB and left centre-back, right-footed RB and right centre-back. Natural angles make playing out from the back easier.

label: Midfield engine
description: Average base stamina of the midfielders: 78 or more gives +4; under 65 costs -6, because tired midfielders fade after the hour.

label: Shared nationality
description: +1 for each pair of neighbours from the same country (at most +4): easier communication on the pitch.
